site.name: Mirrai
site.tagline: When they're not here, they're still here.
site.trust: Open source · Your data never leaves your machine · MIT
site.description: Upload your chat history and rebuild their digital presence. Speak in their voice, then — say goodbye properly. Mirrai is an open-source emotional memory OS. Your data never leaves your machine.

hero.title:
When they're not here,
they're still here.
hero.subtitle: Upload your chat history and rebuild their digital presence. Speak in their voice, then — say goodbye properly.
hero.boundary: Only upload records you have the right to use.

unfinished.title: Some things were left unsaid.
unfinished.body: Late at night you replay a conversation and notice it ended in blank space. Not because there was nothing left to say — because it never got said. You can hand those records to Mirrai. It doesn't bring anyone back; it simply finishes what was left unfinished.
unfinished.quote: You can ask a program this question, but you couldn't ask it to the real person who loved me.

letter.ending: What I always meant to tell you was —

how.title: Three steps, from "like" to "is".

steps.title: Upload your chat history
steps.body: Common export formats supported. The records stay on your own machine — from upload to conversation, they never touch a server.

steps.title: Multi-stage distillation
steps.body: A seven-layer persona: voice, habits, memory, emotional patterns, relational context, unfinished business, and how they'd say goodbye. The process is visible and auditable.

steps.title: Talk in their voice
steps.body: Responses aren't templates — they grow out of your history together. Memory recall is visible; every reply is traceable.

how.hardline: Not "imitating them" — turning "like them" into "is them".

absent.title: A third state: not online, not gone.

cards.title: Letters
cards.body: Write down what you want to say and send it. A day later, a reply arrives in their voice.

cards.title: Can't reach them right now
cards.body: Silence comes with an explanation. You can see their state — not that they ignored you; they haven't reached the moment they can answer.

cards.title: Pause for a while
cards.body: Stop the interruptions, not the relationship. Everything is still here when you come back.

cards.title: What time is it on their side
cards.body: A time zone isn't just a number. It's whether you should send that message at three in the morning.

graduation.title: It isn't designed to keep you. It's designed to let you go.
graduation.manifesto: The product's success metric isn't retention. It's graduation.
graduation.demoHint: Conversation → visible memory recall → farewell letter
graduation.demoPlaceholder: Pre-recorded conversation playback (real version ships in M2)

fidelity.title: "Does it feel like them" isn't mysticism. It's measurable.
fidelity.ruleExample: "Whatever" vs. "whatever you say" — same root, different people, different hearts.
fidelity.local: Everything runs locally and is auditable. Rules are readable; data is inspectable.

points.title: Local data
points.body: Chat history, persona, memory — all of it stays on your machine.

points.title: Fully offline
points.body: With Ollama it runs with the network cable pulled. Cloud LLMs are optional and transparent.

points.title: Open and auditable
points.body: MIT licensed. Distillation, memory, responses — you can read every layer of the code.

points.title: Clear boundaries
points.body: This is a simulation. It is not them. We put that sentence where you can't miss it.

download.title: Install it. Begin a serious goodbye.
download.requirement: Apple Silicon / macOS 13+ · Windows x64 · Docker · Node 24+ (source)
download.boundary: Only upload records you have the right to use.

coda.title:
One day you won't need it anymore —
that's when it's done.

footer.about: Mirrai is an open-source emotional memory OS. It helps you give a relationship the ending it should have had.
